2813-0013 ShogunError.ACCESS_DENIED Access restrictions for general application developers. 1.
When this error occurs due to a call to the shop-jump API in the development environment (dd1), handle it as follows.
Step 1. Access NCMS.
Step 2. Open the ACL Config menu for each application.
Step 3. Register the serial number of the Switch console.

2.
When this error occurs when displaying the Nintendo eShop Nintendo Switch Online page in the development environment, ignore it. This specification is by design.
Operate Nintendo Switch Online Membership Manager if you want a Nintendo Switch Online membership in the development environment. For more information, see the Nintendo Switch Online Play Guide.

3.
In a development environment, an error will occur if you use a download code or call the shop-jump API for an item that is not included in the AOC List, Consumable Service List, or Service Ticket List.
An error will also occur if you call the shop-jump API by specifying an NS_UID of an item that does not exist.

4.
Check the following if an error occurs while acquiring item information for a bundle while in a development environment.
* Whether the bundle contains downloadable content, consumable service items, or subscription service items.
* Whether these items are in the AOC List, Consumable Service List, or Service Ticket List.		 HTTP 404; shogun.error.general_purpose An error has occurred.

If you would like to continue using the pass, you will need to purchase it again. Vous ne pouvez pas réactiver le renouvellement automatique pour votre pass car celui-ci n'est plus valide. Si vous souhaitez continuer à utiliser ce pass, vous devez l'acheter à nouveau. Dein Ticket ist bereits abgelaufen, daher kannst du dafür automatische Verlängerungen nicht erneut aktivieren. Wenn du das Ticket weiterhin verwenden möchtest, musst du es erneut kaufen. Tu suscripción ya ha caducado, por lo que no puedes volver a activar la renovación automática. Si quieres seguir usando la suscripción, tendrás que volver a comprarla. Il tuo pass è già scaduto, pertanto non puoi riattivarne il rinnovo automatico. Se vuoi continuare a usufruire del pass, dovrai acquistarlo nuovamente. Je pas is al verlopen, dus je kunt de automatische verlenging ervan niet reactiveren. Als je de pas wilt blijven gebruiken, moet je de pas opnieuw kopen. Uma vez que o passe já expirou, não é possível reativar a renovação automática para o mesmo. Se quiseres continuar a utilizar o passe, terás de voltar a adquiri-lo. Срок действия вашего талона уже истек, поэтому вы не можете восстановить для него автоматическое продление. Если вы хотите продолжить использовать этот талон, потребуется снова купить его. お持ちの利用券の有効期限がすでに切れているため、自動継続購入を再開できません。もう一度購入してください。 由於您的使用券已到期，無法重啟自動繼續購買。請再次購買。 가지고 계신 이용권의 유효 기한이 이미 만료되었으므로 자동 연장 결제을 재개할 수 없습니다. 다시 한번 구입해 주십시오.
